name: United Kingdom
intro: It's 1947. You won the war and went bankrupt doing it. India is leaving; Palestine is a nightmare; the Americans hold your debt. Your bomb program is secret even from most of the cabinet. Are you still a great power, America's partner, or Europe's leader? Pick before the money runs out.

nodes.title: Bankrupt Empire
nodes.situation: Winter fuel crisis; convertibility of sterling collapses. Greece, Turkey and Palestine drain the treasury. Marshall is offering aid.

choices.label: Hand Greece to the US, Take Marshall Aid,…
choices.summary: Hand Greece to the US, Take Marshall Aid, Build the Bomb

effects.insight: the Truman Doctrine is born from your telegram
